summary: Console alerting: metric signal goes silent after analytics schema field deprecation
description:
Issue summary:
Customer dashboards and alerting for DataSynth Labs show gaps and a complete silence for a specific metric series (route.client_version) after we deployed a schema deprecation that removed the legacy 'client_version' ingestion field. The pipeline mapping replaced the field with 'client_release' but older aggregated rollups still expect the old field name which causes the alerting eval to drop the series.

Impact:
- Multiple critical alerting rules for the customer did not fire between 2026-02-27 23:40 and 2026-02-28 02:10 UTC.
- Dashboard panels that pivot on client_version show empty series.
- Billing/usage rollups are intact but per-route breakout metrics appear suppressed.

Environment:
- prod ingestion (us-east), org: DataSynth Labs, project: analytics-ingest-prod
- Console version: 2026.02.1

Observed behavior:
- Per-route time-series that previously had series keyed by client_version now show no series at all.
- Alerts that reference the client_version dimension evaluate to zero-series and end up in a suppressed state (no notifications).

Expected behavior:
- Console should either translate legacy client_version->client_release or generate a series with a fallback label so alerts continue to evaluate.

Customer notes:
- Customer deployed a new SDK which drops client_version and emits client_release on 2026-02-27. They expected a transition window.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Ingest an event set where the 'client_version' field is removed and a new 'client_release' field is present.
2) Wait for aggregation rollup window (hourly).
3) Query console dashboard panel that groups by 'client_version' dimension for last 4 hours.
4) Inspect alert rule that uses group-by client_version to evaluate for spikes.

Expected: panel shows fallback series or a migration mapping; alert evaluates on groups containing 'unknown' or 'legacy'.
Actual: panel returns empty series and alert eval returns no groups.
observed_and_expected:
Observed: silent series, missing alerts. Expected: graceful fallback/mapping or explicit migration path documented.
Note: this is different from an ingest-loss (events exist) — raw events with client_release are present in logs; the console aggregation layer is dropping the series because of schema mismatch during rollup compacting.
investigation_notes:
- On initial triage (Aisha) found raw events in the fast-path Kafka topic containing client_release payloads for DataSynth between 2026-02-27T23:30 and 2026-02-28T01:00 UTC.
- Aggregation job logs show a schema mismatch warning: 'missing field client_version, group-by key skipped'.
- Rollup path uses persisted rollup-schema v1 which enumerates 'client_version' as a grouping key; migration to accept 'client_release' was staged but not enabled in prod.
- Quick check of the aggregation mapping PR (platform PR #2248) shows migration steps but the feature flag 'rollup-schema-v2' is still false in prod in us-east.
- Support forwarded to infra with request to toggle flag for DataSynth org to enable v2 mapping while we coordinate with customer for a controlled cutover.
- SRE (Marco) ran a targeted backfill test on staging: enabling rollup-schema-v2 restored series with fallback labels 'migrated:client_release' and alerts evaluated correctly.
logs_and_artifacts:
- Kafka topic lsr-ingest-us-east partition 12 offsets 1243220-1245400 contain events with 'client_release' present.
- Aggregator logs (aggregator-7-logs): 2026-02-28T00:05:12 WARN Missing group key: client_version for org=DataSynth id=3421
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2248 (schema migration and mapping).
- Dashboard snapshot: https://app.redwood.io/dash/snapshot/DS-20260228-001 (internal link, expires 7 days).
- Slack thread: #support (link: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02SUPPORT/p1677510000000)
temporary_workaround:
1) Enable rollup-schema-v2 feature flag for DataSynth Labs in us-east (suggested by SRE).
2) As long-term: schedule a migration window and run a backfill for rollups covering 2026-02-27T20:00 to 2026-02-28T03:00 UTC.
3) Customer should continue to send client_release and we will keep mapping enabled for 48 hours before flipping off legacy acceptance.
resolution_notes: In progress: SRE prepared a safe rollout that gates on a per-org flag. No permanent fix deployed globally without change window. Backfill job queued and monitoring will validate alert evals. Planned next update 2026-03-01 after backfill completes.
next_steps:
- SRE to enable feature flag for DataSynth (Marco) and confirm alerting behavior (ETA 2026-03-01 02:00 UTC).
- Run backfill for affected rollup buckets (Ops runbook: RB-0423).
- Update migration docs in Confluence and add explicit console migration guide for schema-deprecation events.
- Follow up with customer CS call to coordinate SDK rollout guidance.
